in_sanskrit.name: ईच्छान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who embodies the deepest desires and intentions. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'icch' which means 'to desire' or 'to will'. It is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom, who is often depicted holding a lotus in one hand and a rosary in the other, symbolizing the power of desire and intention in attaining knowledge and wisdom.

in_marathi.name: Ichchhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ichchhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ichchhan is derived from the Sanskrit root 'icch', meaning 'to wish' or 'to desire'. In Hindu mythology, Ichchhan represents the personification of desire and will. This name is believed to bestow upon the child the strength of will and the ability to manifest their desires.
